name: fastx402
description: 80+ pay-per-call tools for your agent (media, data, dates, crypto, web), paid per call in USDC via x402.
long_description: FastX402 gives your AI agent 80+ small, fast tools: background removal, image to SVG, image and video conversion, text to speech, QR codes, YAML/XML/CSV/JSON conversion, Markdown to HTML, text diffs, date math, cron descriptions, time zones, colors, units, IP and DNS lookups, validators, hashing, JWT decoding, Ethereum/Base/Solana balances, token info, transaction status, gas, ENS and Basenames, web page text, screenshots, PDF text, OCR and transcription. There is no account and no API key: each successful call is paid automatically in USDC (Base or Solana) with the x402 protocol, from a wallet you choose. Use a dedicated wallet with a few dollars; the per-call and per-day limits below are a second safety net. The tool list is read live from https://fastx402.tools, so new tools appear on their own.

evm_private_key.title: Base wallet private key (optional)
evm_private_key.description: 0x + 64 hex. A NEW, dedicated wallet holding a few dollars of USDC on Base. Never your main wallet. Fill this or the Solana key.

solana_private_key.title: Solana wallet private key (optional)
solana_private_key.description: Base58 secret key of a NEW, dedicated Solana wallet holding a few dollars of USDC.

max_usd_per_call.title: Max USD per call
max_usd_per_call.description: Any single payment above this is refused.

max_usd_per_day.title: Max USD per day
max_usd_per_day.description: Stops paying once this much was spent today.
